Locked workspaces block all writes to issues, comments, projects, labels, attachments, membership changes, invitations, and workspace settings. Reads remain unaffected.

Billing changes, workspace deletion, notification housekeeping, and Taskflow background jobs are also blocked while locked. I will place the lock check in the service layer after permission checks, since background jobs may call services directly.
